author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **ServerWhitelist v4.0** — The Ultimate Server Management Cog!

All servers the bot is currently in have been automatically whitelisted.

**Core Commands (owner only):**
• `[p]join <id>` — Whitelist a server
• `[p]join remove/blacklist/unblacklist <id>`
• `[p]join servers` — Browse with leave controls
• `[p]join info/search/stats`
• `[p]join purge/leave/lock/unlock`
• `[p]join log #channel` — Event logging

**New in v4.0:**
• 📩 **Whitelist Requests** — Server owners can request via DM button; you approve/deny
• 📝 **Notes & Tags** — Annotate and categorize servers
• 🔍 **Invite Audit** — See who added the bot via audit log
• ⏰ **Temp Whitelist** — `[p]join temp <id> 7d` for time-limited access
• 📏 **Member Requirements** — Min/max member thresholds
• 🔑 **Trusted Inviters** — Auto-whitelist from specific users
• 🔔 **Owner Alerts** — DM notifications for all events
• 💾 **Backup & Restore** — Full config export/import
• 🛡️ Owner DM, auto-ban, attempt tracking, rich logging (from v3)
name: ServerWhitelist
short: The ultimate cog to control which servers the bot can be in — whitelist, blacklist, requests, temp access, trusted inviters, notes, tags, alerts, backup & more.
description: ServerWhitelist v4.0 is the definitive server management cog for Red-DiscordBot. It gives bot owners complete control over which Discord servers the bot operates in. Features include: whitelist/blacklist with paginated views, interactive server browser with leave dropdowns, detailed server info embeds, search, bulk purge, lock mode, rich colour-coded event logging, attempt tracking with auto-ban after configurable threshold, owner DM with customizable message, whitelist request system with approve/deny buttons, server notes and tags for organization, invite audit via Discord audit logs, temporary time-limited whitelist, min/max member requirements, trusted inviters for auto-whitelist, owner DM alerts for all events, full config backup and restore, and comprehensive export. Every action is logged and auditable.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild IDs in a global whitelist, blacklist, join-attempt tracker, notes, tags, and whitelist request queue. No per-user data is collected or stored beyond requester IDs in the request queue.
